method: Use historical genus/length descriptions to retrieve public candidates; compare 792 eight-sequence sets from 13 unique candidate sequences to the existing model; reconstruct sequence order against the Easel alignment checksum; independently verify all eight protein sequences against NCBI; reproduce with a fresh MAFFT alignment and hmmbuild.
purpose: Provenance reconstruction of the existing model, not independent classifier validation or cutoff calibration.
limitations: One experimentally characterized canonical anchor; seven additional homologs are not individually functionally validated by this reconstruction.
Training scores and exact build reproduction do not establish independent sensitivity, specificity or universal Fe(III)-reduction activity.
Some source records use the gene name cbcY; names are preserved as provider annotations rather than treated as experimental functional evidence.
